verdict.rationale: Gmail ships a documented public RESTful API covering messages, threads, labels, drafts, sending, and push-notification watches, with OAuth scopes. Independent developers (Streak and others) report building on it successfully instead of IMAP. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt found at the probed paths, and community reports of a costly security assessment for restricted read scopes and coarse scope granularity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Gmail API is a RESTful API that lets you access Gmail mailboxes and send mail.
The Gmail API lets you view and manage Gmail mailbox data like threads, messages, and labels.
Set up or update a push notification watch on the given user mailbox.
Streak has used the Gmail API to build email snoozing and finds it really nice to use, making interaction with Gmail much easier than IMAP.
